title: Plate fixation versus flexible intramedullary nails for management of closed femoral shaft fractures in the pediatric population: A systematic review and meta-analysis of the adverse outcomes.

answer.design_quote: When appropriate, individual study incidences of adverse events were pooled, and meta-analysis was performed using RevMan5 (The Cochrane Collaboration, Copenhagen, Denmark).
answer.k_quote: Thirteen papers (2 prospective randomized controlled trials and 11 retrospective cohorts) reported 805 closed diaphyseal femoral fractures in 801 children (559 males, 242 females).
